notes.title: Seasons of Rocco Official Release
notes.content:
Dear Cozy Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that Seasons of Rocco is now officially released and ready for you to immerse yourself in the heartwarming world of Rocco! Will you help Rocco prepare for the winter season? 

What to Expect: 
Explore the autumn season as you help Rocco gather and sort fruit at his Tree House. 
Plant new fruit trees in the spring to ensure a bountiful harvest for the winter ahead.

📢 Important Notice for Playtesters:
If you've been a part of our playtesting journey, we sincerely thank you! Please note that with the official release, we recommend deleting your save data to fully enjoy the polished and finalized experience. You can do this from the main menu.

How to Delete Save Data:
Navigate to the main menu.
Click on the “Reset” button.
Click on “Play” to start your new journey!

Thank you for being a part of our journey! We can't wait for you to experience the complete Seasons of Rocco adventure. 🍎🍊🍐🍋


Your support means the world to us. Are you ready to start this adventure? 

With love and full bellies,

Vivid Visions Studios 🍁❄️🌱☀️

notes.title: Rocco needs Playtesters!
notes.content:
🍂 Join the Seasons of Rocco Beta Test! 🍂

Hello, Season of Rocco Gamers! We're thrilled to invite you to be a part of our beta testing phase for Seasons of Rocco! 🌟 Immerse yourself in Rocco's charming world, where each season brings new adventures.

🎮 What to Expect:
Explore the autumn season as you help Rocco gather and sort fruit at his Tree House.
Plant new fruit trees in the spring to ensure a bountiful harvest for the cozy winter ahead.

🔧 Help Us Polish the Experience:
Your valuable feedback will play a crucial role in refining Seasons of Rocco. We want to hear about your gameplay experiences, any technical hiccups, and your suggestions to make the game even better! Our Feedback form: [url=https://forms.gle/jzb3aAVW8H85f9vJ9]https://forms.gle/jzb3aAVW8H85f9vJ9[/url]

📆 How to Join:
Visit our Steam page.
Find the "Beta" section and opt into the beta version.
Play, explore, and share your thoughts with us with the "Feedback" button on the main menu!

P.s. Streaming or recording the beta is allowed and even encouraged! We would love to see your reactions
Thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🦝🍎
